name: Nose Mountain
summary: Steel lookout tower bought in fiscal 1947–48 and erected in fiscal 1948–49 with a cabin, engine house and road; Alberta's layer dates the present 18 m tower to 2004.
design: Steel lookout tower, 18 m (59 ft) tall in the Alberta layer; the 1948–49 tower was steel and stood at the site with a cabin and an engine house

access.note: No public visiting arrangement found. The layer's access mode is drive. Level carried from the brief's record; no source read states a closure.

visit.trail_note: No visitor route described; the layer lists the access mode as drive

events.note: Steel tower purchased for Nose Mountain and at Grande Prairie; tentative tower location chosen. Canada Lookouts transcription of the annual report for the year ended 31 March 1948 (fiscal 1947–48); the page labels it 1947, and the story uses the fiscal-year span.

New steel lookout tower erected with a cabin and engine house; about 40-mile bulldozed road built to give access. Page labels the entry 1948 but cites the report for the year ended 31 March 1949 (fiscal 1948–49); the story uses the fiscal-year span 1948–49.
Present structure per Alberta's wildfire lookout layer (year of construction). The sources read do not say whether it replaced the 1948 tower or stands on the same spot.
